scope: Same compressed payload, normalized values, affine metadata and Q/K. Same persistent resources. V9 restores per-token weighted accumulation instead of V8 pair arithmetic. Sharing texels can still change compiler scheduling. Source-level instruction count is not measured hardware instruction count or DRAM traffic. Precompressed warm repeated fixtures, not a model-quality, dynamic-cache or full-inference result. T2048 and T8192 repeat real fixture blocks.
